description: This file implements functions and classes for managing a simple disk cache index, including serialization/deserialization, file operations, and index recovery.

classes.name: SimpleIndexPickle
classes.description: A subclass of base::Pickle with a method to validate the header.

classes.name: SimpleIndexFile::IndexMetadata
classes.description: Holds metadata about the index, including serialization/deserialization logic.

classes.name: SimpleIndexLoadResult
classes.description: Stores the result of loading or restoring the index, including entries and status flags.

methods.name: CalculatePickleCRC
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum of a pickle payload.

methods.name: WritePickleFile
methods.description: Writes a pickle to a file using provided file operations.

methods.name: ProcessEntryFile
methods.description: Processes a cache entry file during index restoration, updating the entries set.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes index metadata and entries into a pickle.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes pickle data into index metadata and entries.

methods.name: SyncLoadFromDisk
methods.description: Loads index data from disk, validating and deserializing it.

methods.name: SyncRestoreFromDisk
methods.description: Reconstructs index entries by scanning cache directory files.

methods.name: LoadIndexEntries
methods.description: Asynchronously loads index entries, possibly from disk.

methods.name: WriteToDisk
methods.description: Serializes and writes index data to disk.
